title: I believe, O Lord, help my unbelief
html_source:
From the New Testament (Mark 9, 17-24).
A man tells Jesus he has a possessed son and informs him that he asked his apostles to cure him, but they failed.
Being slightly irritated, Jesus said: “O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.”

After that he asked the father whether he really believed his son can be cured from the evil spirit. The father replied: “Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.”
